title: Laura Pausini Releases New Single Ahead of Stage Return
seoTitle: Laura Pausini Drops New Single, Prepares for World Tour
subtitle: Italian Singer Debuts “Siamo soli nell’immenso vuoto che c’è” and Prepares for European Shows
excerpt: Laura Pausini released “Siamo soli nell’immenso vuoto che c’è,” a reinterpretation of Raf, on September 4th, and announced the restart of her World Tour.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Laura Pausini returned to the airwaves with the release of her single “Siamo soli nell’immenso vuoto che c’è,” a reinterpretation of Raf, on September 4th, and announced the resumption of her World Tour 2026/2027, which will begin on October 1st.

The Single Accompanying the Tour

The album “Io Canto 2,” released on February 6th by Warner Records / Warner Music Italy, already includes the new single, written by Raffaele Riefoli and Beppe Dati and restructured by Paolo Carta. Pausini described the song as one of the first she prepared for the album and said she kept it a secret so that it would accompany the Italian and European tour.

Music Video Produced in Toronto

The music video, directed by Gaetano Morbioli, was filmed in Toronto and shows the singer with large white feathered wings, created by a Canadian costume designer.

Event in Ravenna and Fan Meet-and-Greet

On August 30th, the Pala De André hosted the twenty-first official meeting of the Laura Pausini Official Fanclub. Over 3,000 registered members from around the world participated in the “Sneak Peek Fan Club Party,” where the artist presented the schedule for the European leg of the tour and performed the new single live.

Participation in the Formula 1 Grand Prix

Before hitting the road, Pausini will headline the Formula 1 Grand Prix in Monza on September 6th.

World Tour 2026/2027 Projections

The World Tour 2026/2027 will kick off on October 1st, visiting arenas in major Italian and European cities, and will continue until the end of 2027. The eleventh world tour has already sold 450,000 tickets, with several sold-out dates.

With information from Ravenna Notizie.
